svg.aria-label: What the session holds after each step of fixing one failing test. git clone adds a git token and the repo on disk, read code adds the whole repo, pnpm install adds postinstall scripts and process.env, write fix adds an LLM-written fix, pnpm test adds test fixtures and exec plus network, and git push adds repo write. By the push the session holds 9 things, and nothing is ever handed back. Authority is blue, untrusted input orange.
svg.text: what the session holds after each step
and nothing is ever handed back
